_readme: Per-sequence provenance for the all-sky capture sequences.
'frames' and 'geometry' are measured from the delivered files and are filled in.
Everything else is editorial and must come from the capture team. Leave a field
as null or "" and the ingest OMITS it from the catalog rather than inventing a
value: the site, coordinates, timestamps, instrument, licence and citation will
simply not appear in the UI or the API until they are supplied here.
startedAt  ISO-8601 UTC instant of frameIndex 0, e.g. "2026-03-14T09:00:00Z".
frameIntervalSeconds  seconds between consecutive frameIndex values.
Both are required to derive a real capturedAt per frame.
site       human-readable capture site, e.g. "Kumasi, Ghana".
latitude / longitude  decimal degrees of the camera.
instrument All-sky camera make/model.
title      The collection's name on the site: the cloud type the sequence shows,
as read off its frames by the archive's curator.
collection Slug grouping sequences captured at the same site. Sequences that
share a slug become one catalogue collection. Defaults to the sequence.
station    the synoptic station's name, shown as the collection's location name.
wmoId      the station's WMO index number.
Stations and coordinates are GMet synoptic stations (WMO index and position from
NOAA's ISD station history).
The station each sequence is assigned to, startedAt and frameIntervalSeconds are
placeholders pending the capture team's records: every sequence is spread over the
same 06:00-18:00 UTC window on one day.
Apply to an existing database with `wascat ingest provenance`.
